references.observed: Downstream photo shows brown masonry, rounded upper apertures, lower mouths in the sloping apron, pier interruptions and a cross-braced traveling gantry.
Site report identifies the 600 m masonry section, 80 low sluices, 26 m maximum section and 421.7 m upper operating stage.
Nile Basin flood assessment lists 72 working spillway gates and the 413.8 m sill.
The rail bridge crosses the same west-to-east dam crest at the reservoir transition. Two irrigation canals on the western bank help distinguish the site.
